name: Shinkawa Yutaka
source: Yutaka is also a student of Gunjo Academy. [url=https://vndb.org/c3658]Taichi[/url] met him by chance one day and they became friends. Because of a certain event in his past, Yutaka has lost his ability to walk normally and has to use crutches.
